title: Sundry
summary: SUN'DRY, adjective Several; divers; more than one or two. [This word, like several, is indefinite; but it usually signifies a small number, sometimes many.] I have composed sundry collects. Sundry foe

inlines.v: SUN'DRY, adjective Several; divers; more than one or two. [This word, like several, is indefinite; but it usually signifies a small number, sometimes many.] I have composed sundry collects. Sundry foes the rural realm surround.
